<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>MD. Shahidul Islam — Amazon Seller Central & FBA Specialist</title>
<meta name="description" content="Amazon Seller Central & FBA Specialist with 5+ years experience. Also managing Shopify, Etsy & eBay stores.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#F1EEE6;
    --bg-alt:#E9E4D6;
    --card:#FFFFFF;
    --ink:#15202B;
    --ink-soft:#5B6472;
    --line:#DAD3C2;
    --amazon:#DD7A0C;
    --amazon-dark:#A85C08;
    --amazon-tint:#FBEBD6;
    --teal:#1E6F5C;
    --teal-tint:#E1EFEA;
    --navy:#0E1A2B;
    --navy-soft:#1B2A40;
    --font-d:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
    --font-b:'Inter',sans-serif;
    --font-m:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    font-family:var(--font-b);
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:1080px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 28px;}
  section{padding:64px 0;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-d); letter-spacing:-0.01em;}

  /* ---------- eyebrow / labels ---------- */
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:var(--font-m);
    font-size:12px;
    letter-spacing:.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--amazon-dark);
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{
    content:"";
    width:22px; height:2px;
    background:var(--amazon);
    display:inline-block;
  }
  .eyebrow.teal{color:var(--teal);}
  .eyebrow.teal::before{background:var(--teal);}

  /* ---------- nav ---------- */
  nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(241,238,230,.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  nav .wrap{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:14px 28px;
  }
  .nav-mark{font-family:var(--font-d); font-weight:700; font-size:16px;}
  .nav-mark span{color:var(--amazon);}
  .nav-links{display:flex; gap:26px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;}
  .nav-links a{
    text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding-bottom:2px; border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
    transition:.2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink); border-color:var(--amazon);}
  @media(max-width:720px){.nav-links{display:none;}}

  /* ---------- hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    background:var(--navy);
    color:#F3EFE4;
    padding:76px 0 60px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-120px;
    width:420px; height:420px; border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(221,122,12,.28), transparent 70%);
  }
  .hero-inner{position:relative; z-index:2;}
  .hero-flex{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 260px;
    gap:44px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .hero-photo-wrap{
    position:relative;
    width:240px; height:240px;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .hero-photo-wrap::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; inset:-10px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--amazon), transparent 60%);
    opacity:.55;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .hero-photo{
    position:relative; z-index:2;
    width:240px; height:240px;
    border-radius:50%;
    object-fit:cover;
    border:4px solid rgba(243,239,228,.9);
    box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
  @media(max-width:820px){
    .hero-flex{grid-template-columns:1fr; text-align:center;}
    .hero-photo-wrap{order:-1;}
    .platform-row, .cta-row, .hero-meta{justify-content:center;}
  }
  .hero .eyebrow{color:#E5A85B;}
  .hero .eyebrow::before{background:#E5A85B;}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(34px,5.2vw,54px);
    font-weight:700;
    line-height:1.05;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .hero .role{
    font-size:clamp(16px,2.2vw,20px);
    color:#C8CDD6;
    font-weight:500;
    margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .role strong{color:#F3EFE4; font-weight:600;}
  .platform-row{
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;
    margin-bottom:30px;
  }
  .chip{
    font-family:var(--font-m);
    font-size:11.5px;
    letter-spacing:.03em;
    padding:6px 12px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    border-radius:20px;
    color:#D8DCE3;
  }
  .chip.pri{
    background:var(--amazon);
    color:#1A0F02;
    border-color:var(--amazon);
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .hero-meta{
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:22px;
    font-size:13.5px; color:#B7BEC9;
    margin-bottom:32px;
    font-family:var(--font-m);
  }
  .hero-meta b{color:#F3EFE4; font-family:var(--font-b); font-weight:700;}
  .cta-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:12px 20px;
    border-radius:8px;
    font-weight:600; font-size:14px;
    text-decoration:none;
    transition:.2s;
    border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .btn-pri{background:var(--amazon); color:#1A0F02;}
  .btn-pri:hover{background:#c46c0a;}
  .btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3); color:#F3EFE4;}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#F3EFE4;}

  /* ---------- about ---------- */
  .about-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr; gap:44px;
    align-items:start;
  }
  .about-grid p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:15.5px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .info-cards{display:grid; gap:12px;}
  .info-card{
    background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:16px 18px;
  }
  .info-card .label{
    font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:10.5px;
    text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em;
    color:var(--amazon-dark); margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .info-card .val{font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;}
  .info-card .sub{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:13px; margin-top:2px;}
  @media(max-width:820px){.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- section header ---------- */
  .sec-head{margin-bottom:30px;}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,32px); font-weight:700;}
  .sec-head .desc{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14.5px; max-width:640px; margin-top:8px;}

  /* ---------- amazon section (featured) ---------- */
  .amazon-block{
    background:var(--amazon-tint);
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .skill-chip-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; margin-bottom:40px;}
  .skill-chip{
    background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid #E7D2AE;
    padding:8px 14px;
    border-radius:7px;
    font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
    color:var(--navy);
  }
  .card-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:16px;
    margin-bottom:44px;
  }
  .svc-card{
    background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid #E7D2AE;
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .svc-card .num{
    font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:11px;
    color:var(--amazon-dark); margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .svc-card h3{font-size:15.5px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .svc-card p{font-size:13.3px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  @media(max-width:820px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(max-width:560px){.card-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* pipeline / signature element */
  .pipeline{
    position:relative;
    display:flex;
    overflow-x:auto;
    gap:0;
    padding-bottom:10px;
    scrollbar-width:thin;
  }
  .pipe-step{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:150px;
    position:relative;
    padding:0 14px 0 0;
  }
  .pipe-step .track{
    display:flex; align-items:center;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .pipe-dot{
    width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--navy);
    color:#F3EFE4;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
    flex:0 0 auto;
    z-index:2;
  }
  .pipe-step:first-child .pipe-dot{background:var(--amazon); color:#1A0F02;}
  .pipe-line{
    height:2px; flex:1;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--amazon-dark) 0 6px, transparent 6px 11px);
  }
  .pipe-step:last-child .pipe-line{display:none;}
  .pipe-label{font-size:12.8px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.3;}

  /* teal variant of pipeline, used for Shopify / Etsy / eBay */
  .pipeline.teal-pipe{margin-top:10px;}
  .pipeline.teal-pipe .pipe-step{width:118px;}
  .pipeline.teal-pipe .pipe-dot{
    width:28px; height:28px; font-size:10.5px;
    background:var(--teal); color:#EAF4F0;
  }
  .pipeline.teal-pipe .pipe-step:first-child .pipe-dot{background:var(--teal); color:#EAF4F0;}
  .pipeline.teal-pipe .pipe-line{
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal) 0 6px, transparent 6px 11px);
  }
  .pipeline.teal-pipe .pipe-label{font-size:11.8px;}

  /* work gallery */
  .gallery{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap:16px;
    margin:36px 0 44px;
  }
  .gallery-card{
    background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid #E7D2AE;
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .gallery-card .shot{
    width:100%; display:block;
    border-bottom:1px solid #E7D2AE;
    cursor:zoom-in;
  }
  .gallery-card .gc-body{padding:16px 18px 18px;}
  .gallery-card h3{font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:8px;}
  .gallery-card ul{list-style:none; display:grid; gap:5px;}
  .gallery-card li{
    font-size:12.6px; color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding-left:14px; position:relative;
  }
  .gallery-card li::before{
    content:"—"; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--amazon-dark); font-weight:700;
  }
  @media(max-width:820px){.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* lightbox */
  .lightbox{
    display:none;
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:100;
    background:rgba(14,26,43,.92);
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:30px;
  }
  .lightbox.open{display:flex;}
  .lightbox img{max-width:100%; max-height:88vh; border-radius:8px;}
  .lightbox-close{
    position:absolute; top:22px; right:28px;
    color:#F3EFE4; font-size:28px; cursor:pointer;
    font-family:var(--font-m);
  }

  /* ---------- other marketplaces ---------- */
  .mp-columns{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:20px;
  }
  .mp-card{
    background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:22px;
  }
  .mp-card .mp-title{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    font-family:var(--font-d); font-weight:700; font-size:17px;
    margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .mp-dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); display:inline-block;}
  .mp-card .mp-tag{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .mp-list{list-style:none; display:grid; gap:7px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .mp-list li{
    font-size:13.3px; color:var(--ink);
    padding-left:16px; position:relative;
  }
  .mp-list li::before{
    content:"—"; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--teal); font-weight:700;
  }
  .mp-flow{
    font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:11.5px;
    color:var(--teal);
    background:var(--teal-tint);
    padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px;
    line-height:1.6;
  }
  @media(max-width:780px){.mp-columns{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- toolbox ---------- */
  .tool-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}
  .tool-chip{
    background:var(--navy); color:#F3EFE4;
    font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:12.5px;
    padding:9px 15px; border-radius:20px;
  }

  /* ---------- why work with me ---------- */
  .why-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:16px;}
  .why-card{
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:12px; padding:20px;
    background:var(--card);
  }
  .why-card .ic{font-size:22px; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .why-card h3{font-size:14.5px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .why-card p{font-size:12.8px; color:var(--ink-soft);}
  @media(max-width:820px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}}
  @media(max-width:480px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

  /* ---------- contact / footer ---------- */
  footer{
    background:var(--navy);
    color:#F3EFE4;
    padding:60px 0 34px;
  }
  .contact-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr; gap:40px;
    margin-bottom:40px;
  }
  footer h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,34px); margin-bottom:12px;}
  footer .lead{color:#B7BEC9; font-size:14.5px; max-width:420px; margin-bottom:26px;}
  .contact-list{display:grid; gap:14px;}
  .contact-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;
    font-size:14px;
    text-decoration:none;
    color:#F3EFE4;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    padding-bottom:12px;
  }
  .contact-item .ic{
    width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:8px;
    background:rgba(221,122,12,.18);
    color:#E5A85B;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    flex:0 0 auto; font-size:15px;
  }
  .contact-item .lbl{font-family:var(--font-m); font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#8D95A2; display:block; margin-bottom:2px;}
  @media(max-width:780px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .foot-bottom{
    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    padding-top:20px;
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;
    font-size:12.5px; color:#8D95A2;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{height:6px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--line); border-radius:4px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="nav-mark">SHAHIDUL<span>.</span></div>
    <div class="nav-links">
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a href="#amazon">Amazon</a>
      <a href="#other">Shopify / Etsy / eBay</a>
      <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero-inner">
    <div class="hero-flex">
      <div>
        <div class="eyebrow">eCommerce Marketplace Specialist</div>
        <h1>MD. Shahidul Islam</h1>
        <div class="role">Amazon Seller Central Operation &amp; Listing Specialist — helping brands <strong>list, launch and scale</strong> on the world's biggest marketplaces.</div>

        <div class="platform-row">
          <span class="chip pri">Amazon Seller Central</span>
          <span class="chip pri">Amazon FBA</span>
          <span class="chip">Shopify</span>
          <span class="chip">Etsy</span>
          <span class="chip">eBay</span>
        </div>

        <div class="hero-meta">
          <span><b>5+ yrs</b> Amazon Experience</span>
          <span><b>EEE</b> Graduate</span>
          <span><b>Dhaka</b>, Bangladesh</span>
        </div>

        <div class="cta-row">
          <a class="btn btn-pri" href="mailto:Shahidulislam660281@gmail.com">Email Me</a>
          <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/md-shahidul-islam-00a1b51a4" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View LinkedIn</a>
          <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="tel:+8801518317334">Call / WhatsApp</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="hero-photo-wrap">
        <img class="hero-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="MD. Shahidul Islam">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <div class="wrap about-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow">About</div>
      <p>Electrical &amp; Electronic Engineering graduate with <strong>5+ years managing Amazon Seller Central accounts and end-to-end FBA operations</strong>. Currently supporting Thrilltons Tech Inc. and Unordinary Pty Ltd, handling catalog and listing management, inventory planning, SEO, and account health.</p>
      <p>Alongside Amazon, I also run Shopify, Etsy, and eBay stores for clients who sell across multiple channels — one point of contact for the whole marketplace stack.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="info-cards">
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="label">Current Role</div>
        <div class="val">Amazon Seller Central Specialist</div>
        <div class="sub">Thrilltons Tech Inc. &amp; Unordinary Pty Ltd.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="label">Education</div>
        <div class="val">B.Sc. in Electrical &amp; Electronic Engineering</div>
        <div class="sub">World University of Bangladesh (WUB)</div>
      </div>
      <div class="info-card">
        <div class="label">Objective</div>
        <div class="val">Data-driven marketplace growth</div>
        <div class="sub">Listing quality, SEO &amp; operations that convert</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- AMAZON — MAIN FOCUS -->
<section id="amazon" class="amazon-block">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">Primary Focus</div>
      <h2>Amazon Seller Central &amp; FBA</h2>
      <div class="desc">Five-plus years running the full Amazon lifecycle — from catalog build to account health — for growing brands.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="skill-chip-row">
      <span class="skill-chip">Bulk Listing &amp; Flat Files</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">FBA Shipment Creation</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">Variation Troubleshooting</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">Listing SEO &amp; Keyword Research</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">Inventory Planning</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">Account Health Monitoring</span>
      <span class="skill-chip">A+ Content &amp; Product Video</span>
    </div>

    <div class="card-grid">
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">01 · Listing &amp; Catalog</div>
        <h3>Catalog Management</h3>
        <p>Bulk listings, flat files, variations, FNSKU &amp; box labels — built right the first time.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">02 · Discoverability</div>
        <h3>SEO &amp; Content</h3>
        <p>Keyword research, backend search terms, and A+ Content. Successfully optimized live listings to increase average CTR from 2.5% to 4% and boost Conversion Rate (CR) from 12% to 17%.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">03 · Fulfillment</div>
        <h3>Inventory &amp; Shipments</h3>
        <p>FBA replenishment, shipment plans, and fixes for stranded inventory.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">04 · Compliance</div>
        <h3>Account Health</h3>
        <p>Resolving suppressed listings, IP complaints, and performance metrics.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">05 · Troubleshooting</div>
        <h3>Issue Resolution</h3>
        <p>Fixing listing errors (e.g. 8560, 8058) and staying policy-compliant.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="svc-card">
        <div class="num">06 · Diagnostics</div>
        <h3>Store Audit</h3>
        <p>Full account audits to analyze listing performance metrics, identifying growth areas to scale overall store CR.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="eyebrow">Work In Action</div>
    <div class="gallery">
      <div class="gallery-card">
        <img class="shot" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Single product creation and optimization in Amazon Seller Central" onclick="openLightbox(this.src)">
        <div class="gc-body">
          <h3>Single Product Creation &amp; Optimization</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Building Amazon listings manually from scratch with precise category mapping</li>
            <li>Complete attribute optimization &amp; variation configuration until 100% data readiness</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="gallery-card">
        <img class="shot" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bulk catalog upload and flat file fixing in Amazon Seller Central" onclick="openLightbox(this.src)">
        <div class="gc-body">
          <h3>Bulk Catalog Uploads &amp; Flat File Fixing</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Executing high-volume inventory updates using Excel flat files (.xlsm)</li>
            <li>Analyzing processing summaries to troubleshoot &amp; override system errors</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="gallery-card">
        <img class="shot" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Amazon account health and compliance management" onclick="openLightbox(this.src)">
        <div class="gc-body">
          <h3>Account Health &amp; Compliance Management</h3>
          <ul>
            <li>Maintaining a perfect 1,000/1,000 Account Health Rating (AHR)</li>
            <li>0 policy compliance issues — complete store safety against deactivation</li>
